description: Personal data is not encrypted in transit or at rest where appropriate, exposing data to unauthorized access. Encryption protects data confidentiality by rendering it unreadable without proper decryption keys.
applicability: Applicable to systems transmitting or storing personal data, particularly sensitive personal data or data processed at scale. Includes databases, backups, API communications, and file storage systems.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through infrastructure review, code analysis, and network traffic inspection. Check for unencrypted database connections, HTTP instead of HTTPS, unencrypted storage volumes, plaintext backups, and missing TLS/SSL configurations. Review encryption key management practices.
